name: Operator /status upgrade + topic mapping fix + Achiri scaffold
goal: Give the operator a rich /status command with real pipeline data, fix experiment tracking to show real topic names, and scaffold Achiri config before the Apr 11 Phase 2A gate

tasks.title: Upgrade Telegram /status — read publish-ledger, experiments, readiness
tasks.description: Rewrite handleStatus() in commands.ts. Reads publish-ledger.jsonl (published today/total), experiments.jsonl (top formula pass rate), env vars (readiness %). Falls back gracefully when files missing.

tasks.title: Fix topic-to-experiment mapping — use topic_performance.topic_tags

tasks.acceptance_criteria: After mock run, viral-topics.json contains real topic strings from PerformanceSignal.topic_performance.topic_tags.

tasks.title: Achiri Phase 2A scaffold — agent config + cultural spec
tasks.description: Create kognai-agents/achiri/agent.yaml and config.json with personality, language/cultural config, tier pricing, kill switch thresholds. voice_before_memory: true.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: agent.yaml and config.json exist. voice_before_memory=true. Cultural markers documented.
